parts:
I want to fit a generalized additive negative spatiotemporal model to assess the effects of climate variability on malaria incidence. Here, I want to evaluate the nonlinear or smoothed effects of rainfall, etc. 
The code works for two variables. However, I didn't get result for the full model which is iterating for several days, and sometimes it reported that your computer is low memory. The r-inla code is given as: 

BEM_2<-TM~-1+T_sin+T_cos+LLIN_ATLEASTONE+Elevatn+f(Landsurf_temp,model="rw1")+f(Rain_fall,model="rw1")+f(Soil_mois,model="rw1")+f(NDVI,model="rw1")+ Relative.humidity+f(Min_temp, model = "rw1")+f(Max_temp,model="rw1")+f(FiD1,model="bym",graph=Amhara_shape,hyper = list(prec.unstruct=list(prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.001)),prec.spatial=list(prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.001)))) +f(Month_1,model="rw2") +f(Month_2,model="iid") + f(FiD.T,model="iid")

bem.mod_2<-inla(formula=BEM_2, family ="nbinomial",data=M_Dat,offset=Pop,    control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),control.compute=list(config=TRUE,cpo=TRUE,dic=TRUE,waic=TRUE))

Any help is appreciated regarding solving the problem of computation time which takes several days?  The spatial polygons have 152 districts to be accounted for spatial autocorrelations
